headings.description: Expressive and modern. Unbounded for a premium, slightly futuristic neon feel.

body.description: Clean, highly readable geometric sans-serif to contrast with expressive headers.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-filter: blur(16px); background: rgba(18, 18, 26, 0.6); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-all hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(124,58,237,0.6)]
buttons.accent: bg-accent text-black rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-all hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(245,158,11,0.6)]
buttons.glass: bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/10 text-white rounded-full px-6 py-3 hover:bg-white/10

navigation.style: fixed bottom-0 w-full bg-[#0A0A0F]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-white/5 pb-safe pt-2 px-6 flex justify-between items-center z-50

layouts.spacing: Generous. Use p-6 to p-8 for main sections. Gap-4 to gap-6 for lists.
layouts.grid: Mobile-first. Horizontal scrolling (overflow-x-auto, snap-x) for avatars and match cards. Vertical stack for active lounges.
layouts.alignment: Left-aligned content for profiles and cards to maintain reading flow. Center headers or icons when appropriate.

motion.hover: Scale up slightly (scale-105) for interactive elements. Add neon glow on hover or active state.
motion.entrance: Fade in and slide up (translate-y-4 to translate-y-0) on mount.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on #0A0A0F and #12121A passes WCAG AAA. Primary purple and gold used mostly for accents/borders/glows. Use bold text when using primary color for text.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g. data-testid='nav-home-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application using React and Tailwind CSS.
Ensure dark mode is forced and there's no light mode toggle. The app background MUST be #0A0A0F.
Implement the Bottom Navigation bar as a fixed glassmorphic element at the bottom, overlapping the content.
Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) with duotone style for the premium nightlife vibe.
Implement horizontal scroll for 'People Online' (avatars with green dot) and 'New Matches' (cards). Use 'hide-scrollbar' utility classes.
For the Radio Player, create a small floating or sticky mini-player above the bottom navigation, blurred and styled elegantly.
Use 'After Dark' screens with a more intense Gold/Neon glow or darker aesthetics.
CRITICAL: Include data-testid on ALL interactive elements.
DO NOT use a dashboard layout. Think of it as a premium mobile app for social nightlife.
For avatars and profile images, use the provided Unsplash and Pexels URLs. Apply `object-cover`.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this.
Don't make generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped) with interaction animations.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, scaling, fading).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or surfaces that have content under it. Add glassmorphism (backdrop blur + translucent background).
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.
